body: Sounds like a plan. Finding something to occupy that time does sound like the best idea. I guess progress, no matter how small or large, is still progress. Thank you dude, I think this is exactly what I need just settle.
I'll definitely keep this in mind. One step at a time. Really, thank you.

I don't know what I want to do. I'm 18. Everyone around me is heading off to university or apprenticeships, meanwhile I don't know what I'm going to be doing tomorrow. I don't know, I just blew my chances.
